item.text: I’m opening `test/orders.js` and the nearby context to summarize what the module does and check for defects, then I’ll call out any concrete bugs with file references.

`test/orders.js` exports four small order helpers for a shop backend:

- `calcTotal(items)` sums `price * qty` across line items.
- `applyDiscount(total, code)` applies `SAVE10` or `SAVE20`.
- `averageItemPrice(items)` divides the total by the number of items.
- `formatOrder(order)` renders each line item and appends a formatted total.

Bugs I see:

- [`calcTotal`](file:///C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js#L4) has an off-by-one loop bug: `i <= items.length` should be `i < items.length`. As written, it reads `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`, so `items[i].price` will throw on the last iteration.
- [`calcTotal`](file:///C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js#L4) therefore fails for any non-empty array, and even an empty array will still hit `items[0]` once and throw.
- [`averageItemPrice`](file:///C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js#L17) divides by `items.length` without handling `0`, so it would produce `Infinity`/`NaN` on empty input even if `calcTotal` were fixed.
- [`formatOrder`](file:///C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js#L22) depends on `calcTotal`, so it inherits that crash and cannot format valid orders until `calcTotal` is fixed.

If you want, I can patch the file and add a couple of minimal tests.
